verdict.rationale: Elicit documents its own export of the Library as RIS, tables as CSV/Excel or RIS/BIB, and Research Reports as PDF/Word, so key research data can leave in open formats. However, Systematic Review table export is limited to Pro, Scale and Enterprise plans, and nothing documents a complete account-wide export. Missing for 10: a single 'export everything' or account-level data export, export of agent sessions, chats, projects, skills, alerts and uploaded PDFs, export on all plans, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a full exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Your Elicit Library can be exported as a .ris file, which you can import into Zotero, Mendeley, EndNote, or another reference manager.
Tables can be exported in CSV and Excel format. Certain tables of sources can be exported as RIS or BIB files.
Research Reports can be exported as a PDF or Word file, regardless of which Elicit plan you subscribe to.
Pro, Scale, and Enterprise subscribers can export tables from Systematic Reviews, including the screening recommendation tables and the data extraction table.
Export to RIS, CSV, BIB, PDF and DOCX
